compression.selection_rule: smallest power of two >= 2 * longest duration

pilot.selection: Four per population: longest and shortest duration, then two boundary cases maximizing minimum normalized parameter distance.

scope: No minimal-match placement or astrophysical population weights.
IMRPhenomD has no neutron-star tidal or disruption physics here.
Masses are detector-frame solar masses; spin components are dimensionless.
Longest means maximum estimator result among the selected 96 rows.
Duration estimates are not a verification of FFT edge containment.
Compression and PSD-weighted waveform validation are separate steps.

selection.method: BNS:10 boundary+54 interior; NSBH:16 boundary+16 interior. Coprime midpoint permutations in four transformed coordinates.
